name: Calendar
description: A month to pick a day from, drawn in the page: the date field's calendar without the field. Counts in the reader's calendar, Jalali in Persian, unless told otherwise.

label.description: Names the calendar for a screen reader; it is not drawn.

defaultValue.description: Starts with this day picked; the merchant changes it. A Gregorian ISO 8601 date, whatever calendarSystem draws.

value.description: Pinned: shows exactly what the server sent until the next tree. A Gregorian ISO 8601 date, whatever calendarSystem draws.

minValue.description: The first day that can be picked. A Gregorian ISO 8601 date.

maxValue.description: The last day that can be picked. A Gregorian ISO 8601 date.

unavailableDates.description: Days that cannot be picked, as Gregorian ISO 8601 dates: a booked day, a holiday. Drawn at half; unlike days past the bounds, not struck through.

calendarSystem.description: auto follows the locale: Persian on fa, Gregorian on en.

errorMessage.description: Set means invalid: the calendar shows this message under it.

onChange.description: The day picked, a Gregorian ISO 8601 date.
